name: Aḥmad al-Ḥamalāwī
summary: Azhari teacher of Dār al-ʿUlūm whose Shadhā al-ʿarf fī fann al-ṣarf is the standard ṣarf handbook of modern al-Azhar.
bio: Al-Ḥamalāwī studied at al-Azhar and taught at Dār al-ʿUlūm in Cairo. His Shadhā al-ʿarf, printed at Būlāq in his lifetime, arranges ṣarf in three parts: the verb, the noun, and the rules that apply to both.

sources.title: Shadha al-Urf fi Fan al-Sarf, alkitab.com
